leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure an Express application to apply rate limiting to incoming requests.
Integrate a middleware to set essential security headers in an Express server.
Construct a custom rate limiter with configurable window and maximum request limits.
Apply security headers to mitigate common web vulnerabilities like XSS and clickjacking.
Manipulate response headers to enforce content security policies and control MIME types.
Initialize and bind a rate limiting middleware to specific routes or the entire application.
Update an existing Express server to include both rate limiting and security header protections.
